items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Williams? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no. He was this…Canada Lee!

ctx.x: Belafonte as opposed to Sidney Poitier. Who is a better actor than Sidney Poitier? And, before him, what was his name that did the whiteface thing? One of the first actors played with Charles Laughton and all those people. I’m having a senior moment right now.
